products.name: Calf Extension
products.short: Selectorized Strength — calf extension for legs training on commercial floors.
description: The AFZOX LF Series Calf Extension is a selectorized machine built around loaded plantar flexion through the calf. The movement path is fixed by the frame, so the gastrocnemius take the load without the stabilising demand of a free-weight equivalent.
It is specified for commercial floors, where a station is in use through every peak hour rather than occasionally, and where changeover between members has to take seconds.
Catalogue photography for this range carries Life Fitness branding. AFZOX supplies and installs the equipment; manufacturer and supply terms are confirmed at quotation.
features: Shrouded stack with printed instruction placard
Guided movement path on sealed bearings
Wide bolt-down base with levelling feet
products.primaryApplication: Plantar flexion for legs training.
